thread:
sara: Heads-up — Pelican LoRA merge for CustPel is queued for staging tonight. I pushed a tiny quick-eval pack to s3: s3://redwood-evals/pelican/custpel/quickpack-v1.zip :eyes:
ben: Nice. Do we have baseline numbers for the customer finetune on int4 vs fp16?
liam: Baselines uploaded to the eval dashboard. Short summary: fp16 -> perf baseline 0.78 ROUGE-L, int4 quanted merge drops ~0.03 on average but latency improves ~45ms/token.
eva: Can you paste the smoke command? I'll run it against our staging kernels.
liam: Sure — use the quick runner:
```bash
python tools/run_quick_eval.py \
  --model=pelican-lora-merge:v2 \
  --quant=int4 \
  --prompt-set=s3://redwood-evals/pelican/custpel/prompts.json \
  --output=./out/pelican_quick_v1.json
```
sara: Note: pinned tokenizer v2025-02-18, there's a known mapping tweak for a special token the customer uses. Don't run with latest tokenizer until we confirm.
ben: Ran the quick run on my laptop against a small sample. Observed 3 cases of truncated outputs where fp16 was fine. Pasting snippet:
```text
input id=42 -> int4: "... the total is $1,23"  <- truncated comma vs dot
```
liam: Hmm looks like tokenization split changed for thousands separators. That matches the pinned-token warning. We should re-run with pinned tokenizer.
sara: Good catch. Eva — can you re-run with pinned tokenizer on staging and check the hallucination & formatting tests in the pack?
eva: On it. Kicking off now. ETA ~10m. deploy-bot: build/deploy pelican-lora-merge:v2 -> staging started by @eva at 1769902540
eva: First pass results: formatting tests failed 2/40, hallucination check passed, ROUGE-L delta -0.028 vs fp16 baseline (within our tolerance), avg latency down 38ms/token. Logs: s3://redwood-evals/pelican/custpel/out/staging-run-176990.json
ben: That's acceptable but formatting regression needs a quick fix — probably tokenizer mapping. I can patch the merge to include the special-token alias.
liam: If patch is small, we can canary to 10% on dedicated for validation and run the full quickpack (100 prompts) overnight.
sara: Plan: Ben patches token alias + new merge build; Eva runs canary on dedicated 10% and runs full quickpack; Liam will rerun eval dashboard and compare regression deltas. If all good, promote to staging->prod deploy window Friday.
eva: Acknowledged. I'll watch the canary and post results. :thumbsup:
ben: Pushing patch now — commit 9c3a1f2. Will tag new quickpack v1.1 when build completes.
sara: Thanks team. Keep thread updates short — drop links to outputs only.
ben: Link to patched build: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/123/builds/4567
liam: I'll set a dashboard alert for ROUGE-L delta > 0.04 and formatting-fail count > 0.
eva: Canary started at 1769902702, tests queued.
sara: Great — will sync in the morning if anything blocks. :coffee:
